games.title: The Arcade of Life
games.pitch: A browser-based arcade built on Conway's Game of Life and 50+ cellular automaton rulesets. Play, tweak, and explore emergent behavior across a wide catalog of rules. Visit the sister site ↗.

games.title: Vocal Parkour
games.pitch: A vocal-gesture rhythm game: navigate levels using your voice. Real-time audio-DSP feature extraction and an in-browser classifier turn mic input into game controls — all analysis runs client-side.

games.title: Predictive Markov Wordsearch
games.pitch: A wordsearch generator where the filler letters aren't random — a character-level Markov model trained on reference text predicts plausible language fragments in all eight reading directions, camouflaging hidden words by matching the statistical texture of natural language.
